envelope.description: Exclude generated recovery state from source processing

body.title: Exclude generated recovery state from source processing
body.summary: Verify and, where necessary, extend existing exclusions for project/.insrc/review-runs/investigation-v1/** across Git attribution, indexing and review manifests. Keep metadata-only legacy diagnostic paths and external registrations unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Generated runtime blobs/journal/snapshots never enter selected review packets, index entities or review source manifests.
Existing review diagnostics and legitimate tracked source files retain current behavior; do not broaden exclusion beyond approved runtime namespace unnecessarily.

tests.name: Runtime namespace excluded from Git scope, index and review manifests
